The following subsection, entitled "Corridor Descriptions", discusses upgrading Grange Avenue from Howell Avenue to I-94 into a multi-lane highway and is proposed as Corridor #1. Although this alternate is not a freeway connection it is being discussed with the other corridor locations as a proposal for improving airport access.
The most obvious course of action other than the proposed freeway connection is the "do nothing" alternate. This alternate would be the most easily implemented for it would not require expenditures for land to be converted to transportation use, relocation of homes or businesses, nor involve construction. A "do nothing" alternate would serve to delay maintenance costs and safety improvements and would improve access to General Mitchell Field.
General Mitchell Field has already generated land uses around its periphery. Commercial enterprises serving air passengers, air cargo and airlines as well as industries that transport materials by truck and by air have been attracted by the airport facilities. Recent commercial and residential land developments along the local street system have not been discouraged by this growth nor have the municipalities zoned against it. The City of Milwaukee is presently in the land bank business and is promoting additional commercial and industrial growth for the area. As a result of this growth the existing surface street system in the vicinity of the airport is currently congested.
